l2_experiences.L2_0: Principle: Formalize problem structure early through explicit representation (e.g., grids, tables) to create a dynamic validation framework that cross-checks constraints and assumptions in real-time. The benefits include maintaining cognitive clarity under complexity, preventing cascading errors, and accelerating resolution through proactive verification.
